Label.Text: Items a new game starts with. The logic counts them from the start, and one copy of each leaves the item pool (a Blue Rupee takes its place), so you won't find it again. A song stays in the pool with Song Locations, since every song spot needs a song. Items with tiers count up: add the Hookshot twice for the Longshot. With an adult start, the items that show a window are handed over after the Master Sword pull. Pick an item to add it (click the field and type to search; pick it again for its next tier); double-click one in your list to take it away.

ListView.Name: start_chosen_list
ListView.Tooltip: Double-click to take one away (a tiered item loses its last tier).
